Houthi Attacks on Riyadh Airport Kill 3, Disrupt Flights

Houthi forces launched attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, targeting the main airport and air links. The strikes resulted in the deaths of three Saudi citizens, including an airline pilot. At least 124 flights were suspended following the attacks. The Iran-backed Houthis have intensified their strikes on Saudi Arabia, with one report stating their effort is to cut the Kingdom off from the rest of the world. The Saudi-led coalition has vowed a "firm" response.
